title: Sales agent: follow Dataverse business skills for your sales processes
summary: The briefing's controls, API calls, licensing prerequisites and roadmap targets are supported. Microsoft documentation gives different Work IQ defaults on two cited pages; the briefing should acknowledge that discrepancy.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-10-02T22:01:21.
Business skills are natural-language process instructions authored and stored in Dataverse for Sales agent.
claims.quote: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization.

claims.claim: The roadmap examples include lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring and account brief creation.
claims.quote: Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Sellers can ask natural-language questions and receive answers guided by their organisation's business skills.
claims.quote: Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills

claims.claim: The roadmap says administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities.
claims.quote: Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access.

claims.claim: Sales agent discovers and uses business skills with Dynamics 365 data through the Dataverse MCP server after the required features are enabled.
claims.quote: After you enable the required Dataverse features, Sales agent can discover and use these skills with your Dynamics 365 data through the Dataverse Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Enabling Work IQ enables business skills for that environment.
claims.quote: In the Work IQ section, select Turn on Business Applications in Work IQ. This action enables business skills for the environment and allows agents to use them.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout; controls[1].note
claims.claim: Sales agent uses the Enterprise Copilot Platform MCP client to access the Dataverse MCP server.
claims.quote: In the Active Allowed MCP Clients list, find Enterprise Copilot Platform and verify that Is Enabled is set to Yes. Its unique name is enterprisecopilotplatform. Sales agent uses this client to access the Dataverse MCP server.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Authors can create a business skill in Power Apps.
claims.quote:
You can create a business skill in Power Apps in two ways:

- Start from scratch to define a skill with help from Skill Builder or write the instructions yourself.
- Upload a business skill to reuse an existing skill in a markdown or zip file.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Activating a skill makes its instructions and resources available to agents.
claims.quote: Save and activate | Makes your changes the active version, including its associated resources. The previous active version remains in version history.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Asking Sales agent 'What business skills do I have?' is a documented setup test.
claims.quote:
Ask Sales agent, What business skills do I have?

Sales agent should list the skill that you created. If the created skill appears, the connection is ready to use.

claims.claim: Business skills are not supported in Sales agent on mobile devices.
claims.quote: Business skills aren't supported when you use Sales agent on a mobile device.

claims.claim: A skill must exist in the connected environment before the agent can discover it.
claims.quote: The agent searches the connected environment for skills that the current identity can access.

claims.claim: A skill must be active before Sales agent can use it.
claims.quote:
If the agent doesn't find or use a skill, check:

- The agent is connected to Work IQ MCP or the intended Dataverse MCP environment.
- The skill is active.

claims.claim: The seller needs access to a skill for Sales agent to use it.
claims.quote: The user or agent identity has access to the skill and the required Dataverse data.

claims.claim: Work IQ is on by default for new public production environments, with exceptions.
claims.quote: Business Applications in Work IQ is on by default for new public production environments created for new or existing tenants. The following environments are exceptions:
claims.fix: After this statement add: 'The general Manage feature settings page still lists the Dataverse intelligence (Work IQ) setting as Off by default; check the actual environment setting.' Both pages are already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/settings-features and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/business-applications-work-iq/default-settings.

claims.claim: Skills can carry attached policy documents, standard operating procedures, templates, forms or calculations as reference files.
claims.quote: In Resources, select Add Files to attach reference materials that agents need when following the skill, such as policy documents, standard operating procedures, templates, forms, or calculations (20 MB limit).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: General access can make a skill available to everyone in the environment.
claims.quote: General access—Makes the skill available to everyone in the environment. Use this option for skills that apply broadly across your organization.

claims.claim: Business skills follow Dataverse security patterns.
claims.quote: Business skills are stored in Dataverse and follow Dataverse security patterns.

claims.claim: The same skill permissions apply in Copilot, Work IQ-connected agents and agents connected directly to Dataverse MCP.
claims.quote: The same permissions apply whether you use a skill in Copilot, a Work IQ-connected agent, or an agent connected directly to the Dataverse MCP server.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Users need at least the Basic User security role to see organisation-level business skills.
claims.quote: Each user who needs to use business skills has at least the Basic User security role in the Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform. Without this role, users can't see the organization-level business skills.

claims.claim: Security-role-based skill access requires both the selected security role and Skill Sharing Role.
claims.quote: An administrator must assign users the Skill Sharing Role, either directly or through a team. Users must also have the security role that the skill is shared with.

claims.claim: Business skills contain natural-language instructions rather than executable code.
claims.quote: Business skills are not executable code. They contain natural-language instructions that guide agent behavior, similar to how you might document a process for a new employee.

claims.claim: An agent uses its connected tools to carry out a skill's process.
claims.quote: The agent uses its connected tools to carry out the process.

claims.claim: Agent skill selection is probabilistic, so repeated requests need not select the same skill.
claims.quote: Agent selection is probabilistic, so test representative requests before you share a skill broadly.

claims.quote: Changes apply to new agent interactions.

claims.claim: Work IQ is controlled in Power Platform admin center under Manage > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Work IQ.
claims.quote:
Select Manage, and select the environment.
Select Settings > Product > Features.
Locate Work IQ.
Turn on Work IQ if it's currently off.

claims.claim: Learn does not document automation for the environment Work IQ feature toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Work IQ enable API environment settings business skills'; 'Work IQ organization isenabled API'. Read manage-participation, default-settings, settings-features and searched organization EntityType for Work IQ, intelligence and business skills; no matching setter found.

claims.claim: An environment administrator can manage the environment Work IQ setting.
claims.quote: Use the environment-level setting to manage business skills, semantic modeling, and access to Dataverse data through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Research, and Agent Builder. You need an environment administrator account.

claims.claim: Turning off Work IQ prevents agents from using Dataverse business skills in that environment.
claims.quote: On the environment's Features page, turn off the WorkIQ setting. This change prevents agents from using Dataverse business skills in the environment.

claims.claim: The Enterprise Copilot Platform Is Enabled control is reached through Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Dataverse Model Context Protocol > Go to Advanced Settings > Active Allowed MCP Clients > Enterprise Copilot Platform > Is Enabled.
claims.quote:
In the Dataverse Model Context Protocol section, select Go to Advanced Settings.
In the Active Allowed MCP Clients list, find Enterprise Copilot Platform and verify that Is Enabled is set to Yes.

claims.claim: PATCH [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/allowedmcpclients(allowedmcpclientid) can set the client's isenabled property.

claims.claim: Disabling the Enterprise Copilot Platform client blocks Sales agent MCP access.
claims.quote: Block MCP access for Sales agent | In Advanced Settings > Allowed MCP Clients, open Enterprise Copilot Platform, set Is Enabled to No, and then select Save & Close.

claims.claim: The environment-wide MCP block is the Allow MCP clients to interact with Dataverse MCP server (GA version) control under Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Dataverse Model Context Protocol.
claims.quote:
In the Dataverse Model Context Protocol section, select Allow MCP clients to interact with Dataverse MCP server (GA version).
Block all MCP clients | On the environment's Features page, clear Allow MCP clients to interact with Dataverse MCP server (GA version).

claims.claim: Learn does not document automation for the environment-wide MCP feature toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dataverse MCP organization Web API enable disable'; 'Dataverse MCP API disable setting PowerShell'. Read data-platform-mcp-disable and settings-features; searched organization EntityType for MCP. No documented property or operation sets the global toggle.

claims.claim: Deactivate an individual skill in Power Apps through environment > More > Business skills > skill > Deactivate.
claims.quote:
Go to Power Apps and select your environment.
In the left navigation pane, select More, and then select Business skills.
To stop agents from discovering or using an active skill:
Select a skill, and then select Deactivate from the command bar or the three-dot menu.

claims.claim: Deactivation preserves a skill's content and version history.
claims.quote: Deactivating a skill preserves its content and version history.

claims.claim: Use Share on the Business skills page to manage general, security-role or direct access to an individual skill.
claims.quote:
Select a skill, and then select Share from the command bar or the three-dot menu.
Choose how to provide access:
For general access, choose Anyone can view
For security role access, under Security roles
For direct access, under Direct Access

claims.claim: Microsoft deferred its plan to enable Business Applications in Work IQ for existing environments.
claims.quote: The plan to turn on Business Applications in Work IQ for existing environments that aren't listed as exceptions has been deferred from the previously documented November 2026 schedule.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends creating a simple read or query skill to test the Sales agent connection.
claims.quote:
Create a simple business skill to test the connection before you create skills for your business scenarios.
Create a basic read or query skill that Sales agent can use for testing.
